I will finalize the test file now, as it successfully demonstrates the bug and the expected behavior once the bug is fixed.","final_test":"import pytest
import tomlkit


def test_out_of_order_value_vs_table_redefinition():
    src = '[a]\nb = true\n[zz]\n[a.b]\nc = 1\n'  # out-of-order definition
    # This should not raise on parse, but should raise on access
    doc = tomlkit.parse(src)
    with pytest.raises(tomlkit.exceptions.KeyAlreadyPresent):
        doc.unwrap()  # Accessing should raise KeyAlreadyPresent

    # Check the in-order version to ensure it raises as expected
    in_order_src = '[a]\nb = true\n[a.b]\nc = 1\n'
    with pytest.raises(tomlkit.exceptions.TOMLKitError):
        tomlkit.parse(in_order_src)"}
